items.name: Tonal but "wrong" — the Prokofiev harmonic stab
items.description: Prokofiev writes in keys, with melodies, with cadences — but constantly deploys harmonies that are deliberately, slightly "wrong": a D major chord where C major is expected, a C# in a G major context.
